title: Green peas, canned, cooked, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: Canned green peas are cooked snap peas that retain their bright green color, sweet flavor, and slight crunch after processing. No fat is added during canning, making the product low‑calorie and rich in plant protein, fiber, vitamins, and minerals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green peas belong to the legume family and are one of the oldest cultivated crops.
Canning preserves most of the nutrients even after long shelf life.
In the United States canned peas are a staple in classic dishes such as pea soup and salads.
Peas contain natural antioxidants – flavonoids and carotenoids – that give them their vivid color.
Without added fat, canned peas contain less than 80 kcal per 100 g.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: One cup of canned peas provides about 8 g of protein, useful for vegetarians and athletes.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports digestive health and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Source of vitamin C and vitamin K
items.content: Vitamin C boosts immunity, while vitamin K is essential for blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Contains folate
items.content: Folate is needed for DNA synthesis and is especially important during pregnancy.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The absence of added fat makes the product suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Canned foods often contain added salt for preservation; people monitoring sodium intake should choose low‑salt versions.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to legumes, including peas.

items.title: Bacterial spoilage if improperly stored
items.content: Damaged or opened cans left at room temperature for extended periods can lead to spoilage.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Peas can be eaten straight from the can, added to salads, soups, stews, or used as a sandwich filling. Before serving, drain the liquid and rinse the peas with cold water if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened cans in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep peas in a sealed container in the refrigerator and consume within 3–4 days.
